reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 13 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: The dark olive-green peaked cap retains gold cord/piping, a shiny black visor and two separated front elements with a small upper emblem and lower circular wreath/cockade. Hair remains covered, dark eyebrows are present, and the face has one restrained closed mouth, a smooth chin and no glasses, moustache or beard. The near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze, chest-up crop and warm frontal light with deep visor shadow remain. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder accents, two red collar patches with pale/gold details and one pale-edged dark neck cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The note retains two upper gray-mark rows, largely blank lower paper and the original small dark right-edge tab. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque muted grey-olive backing remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The precise cap-badge, collar-patch and neck-cross details, plus note lettering, are too small to read reliably at source scale. Visible colors, placements, counts, two-row note structure and the small right-edge tab were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
